Tirzepatide in Canada: Research-Grade, and How It Differs From the Pharmacy Product

The dual agonist with the deepest trial record in its class, and the distinction that matters when you buy it as a research material

May 14, 2026·By Adam Reeves · Research Editor, Eppix Labs

Tirzepatide occupies an unusual position in the Canadian research market: it is an approved medicine and a research chemical at the same time, depending entirely on which supply chain a vial came through. Those two things share a molecular structure and share nothing else, and confusing them is the most consequential mistake a buyer in this category makes.

This guide sets out what the molecule is, what its trials actually reported, what "research grade" does and does not mean, and how to verify a lot. Tirzepatide supplied by Eppix Labs is a laboratory research material, not a medicine, and carries no human-use authorization.

What tirzepatide is

Tirzepatide is a synthetic 39-residue peptide with a C20 fatty diacid moiety, engineered as a single molecule that agonizes both the GIP and the GLP-1 receptor. The characterization paper by Coskun et al. (2018) describes the design rationale and the receptor pharmacology, including the deliberately imbalanced potency profile that favours GIP.[3]

The backbone incorporates non-natural residues, notably α-aminoisobutyric acid, to resist DPP-4 cleavage, and the lipidation drives albumin binding and the once-weekly interval. Neither modification is optional decoration: they are what make the molecule behave the way the trials describe.

Research grade against the pharmacy product

The approved product is manufactured under GMP, released against a pharmacopoeial specification, supplied in a device with a regulated label, and dispensed against a prescription. A research-grade vial shares the molecular target and none of that apparatus. It is manufactured to a supplier specification, released against whatever testing the supplier chooses to do, and labelled for laboratory use.

That is not a criticism of research-grade material; it is a description of what it is. An independent batch certificate is the only thing standing in for the regulatory machinery, which is why the certificate deserves more attention here than in almost any other purchase decision.

Sequence and structure

Around 4813 Da, 39 residues, lipidated, with non-natural amino acids in the chain. The synthesis is demanding and the characteristic failure modes are deletion and truncation sequences, which a purity assay records as impurity but does not identify. Mass-spectrometry identity confirmation is what turns a purity number into a statement about the right molecule.

What the published trials reported

Tirzepatide has the deepest published trial record of any compound in this category. Stated as trial findings, not as properties of a research vial:

  • ·Head to head against semaglutide in type 2 diabetes. Frías et al., New England Journal of Medicine 2021 (SURPASS-2): a 40-week open-label randomised trial reporting greater HbA1c and body-weight reduction across tirzepatide doses than semaglutide 1 mg.[1]
  • ·Obesity without diabetes. Jastreboff et al., New England Journal of Medicine 2022 (SURMOUNT-1): a 72-week randomised, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, with mean weight reduction of roughly 15% to 21% across dose arms against 3% for placebo.[2]
  • ·Maintenance after withdrawal. Aronne et al., JAMA 2024 (SURMOUNT-4): a randomised withdrawal design reporting substantial weight regain in participants switched to placebo, which is the cleanest published evidence that the effect is pharmacological rather than durable after discontinuation.[4]
  • ·Obstructive sleep apnoea. Malhotra et al., New England Journal of Medicine 2024 (SURMOUNT-OSA): reduction in apnoea-hypopnoea index against placebo in adults with obesity and moderate-to-severe OSA.[5]

The limit of the evidence

All of the above was generated with GMP material, at defined doses, under clinical supervision, in named indications. None of it transfers to a research vial as a claim. Health Canada has authorized tirzepatide products for specific human indications through a specific supply chain; a research-grade vial sits outside that authorization entirely and carries no human-use permission of any kind.

Verifying a tirzepatide lot

Identity, purity and measured content, in that order of importance. Identity by MS confirms the molecule is tirzepatide rather than a cheaper analogue or an incompletely lipidated variant. HPLC purity quantifies synthesis by-products. Measured content confirms the vial holds what the label says, which is the check a purity-only certificate structurally cannot perform.

Frequently Asked

Is research-grade tirzepatide the same as the pharmacy product?

Same molecule, different supply chain. The approved product is GMP-manufactured, released against a pharmacopoeial specification and dispensed on prescription. A research-grade vial is manufactured to a supplier specification and labelled for laboratory use. An independent batch certificate is what stands in for the regulatory apparatus.

Is tirzepatide legal to buy in Canada as a research material?

Research-grade tirzepatide may be sold and held for laboratory use. It is not authorized for human or veterinary use in that form. Health Canada authorizations for tirzepatide medicines apply to specific approved products through the pharmacy channel, not to research material. This is not legal advice.

How does tirzepatide differ from semaglutide?

Semaglutide is a single-receptor GLP-1 agonist. Tirzepatide agonizes both GIP and GLP-1 receptors from one molecule, with a potency profile weighted toward GIP. SURPASS-2 compared them head to head in type 2 diabetes.

What should a tirzepatide certificate show?

Batch number matching the vial, the named testing laboratory with an independent verification path, MS identity against the expected mass near 4813 Da, HPLC purity, and measured content against the labelled amount.

Why do measured content figures often exceed the labelled amount?

Deliberate overage. Manufacturers commonly fill slightly above the labelled amount so that losses during lyophilization, handling and reconstitution do not leave the vial short. A measured figure modestly above label is normal; a figure below label is the one that should stop a purchase.

How is tirzepatide stored?

Lyophilized: cool, dry, dark, at -20 °C for long-term storage. Reconstituted: refrigerated, used within the window your protocol defines.
